description: Connection Pooling Configuration - Add configurable connection pool settings (min/max pool size, connection lifetime, idle timeout) per provider, integrated into DbToolsOptions and the connection string builder.
steps: Create DBTools/Pooling/ConnectionPoolOptions.cs with a class containing properties: MinPoolSize (int, default 0), MaxPoolSize (int, default 100), ConnectionLifetimeSeconds (int, default 0 meaning unlimited), ConnectionIdleTimeoutSeconds (int, default 300), Pooling (bool, default true). Include XML docs.
Add a ConnectionPoolOptions property to DBTools/Configuration/DbToolsOptions.cs (public ConnectionPoolOptions PoolOptions { get; set; } = new ConnectionPoolOptions()).

Modify the BuildConnectionString() method in DbToolsOptions.cs to append pool-related parameters to the connection string for each provider: SqlServer uses 'Min Pool Size=X;Max Pool Size=X;Connection Lifetime=X;Pooling=X;', PostgreSQL uses 'Minimum Pool Size=X;Maximum Pool Size=X;Connection Idle Lifetime=X;Pooling=X;', MySQL uses 'MinimumPoolSize=X;MaximumPoolSize=X;ConnectionLifeTime=X;Pooling=X;', SQLite uses 'Pooling=X;' (SQLite has limited pool support).
Add a fluent configuration method to DbToolsOptions: ConfigurePooling(Action<ConnectionPoolOptions> configure) that invokes the action on PoolOptions and returns this.

Create DBToolsUnitTest/Pooling/ConnectionPoolOptionsTests.cs with tests: verify default values, verify BuildConnectionString includes pool parameters for each provider, verify ConfigurePooling fluent method works.
Ensure the new using statement for DBTools.Pooling is added where needed.
acceptance_criteria: ConnectionPoolOptions class exists with all specified properties and sensible defaults
DbToolsOptions.BuildConnectionString() includes pool settings in the generated connection strings for all 4 providers
ConfigurePooling fluent method allows modification of pool settings
Unit tests cover default values, connection string generation with pool settings for each provider, and fluent configuration
verification: Verify ConnectionPoolOptions.cs compiles cleanly by checking it has proper using statements and no syntax errors
Verify test file follows MSTest patterns used in existing tests
findings: Added InternalsVisibleTo attribute in DBTools.csproj to allow test project access to internal BuildConnectionString method. This was required since no existing mechanism exposed internal members to the test assembly.
